about_the_game:
The official Tour de France game goes to the next level! Thanks to the Unreal Engine 5, the roads of the Grande Boucle and other iconic races have been brought to life in a whole new way.
With completely reworked landscapes and more realistic lighting effects, the Tour de France experience has never been so close to reality. The memorable sites of this discipline are even more faithfully represented: Champs-Elysées, Trouée d'Arenberg, Mont Ventoux, Mur de Huy and many others are to be rediscovered and visited in Tour de France 2025.



In Tour de France 2025, you can now create your own private games and challenge your friends directly on the roads. Create your own settings and game options, choose the type of stage you want and the length of the race, and prove your supremacy on any fields. Whether it's a stage win or a fight for the Yellow Jersey, every race is the perfect opportunity to show off your skills against the opponents of your choice.



Tour de France 2025 introduces an entirely new refuelling mechanism, revolutionizing race strategies. From now on, at the start of your races, you'll only have access to one type of feed. So it's crucial to plan your efforts carefully. Once you've passed the feed zone, you can choose between Energel and Turbogel and use whichever you like, whenever you like.
The Turbogel now gives you immunity for a few seconds, allowing you to attack without losing energy. It's up to you to make the most of this new mechanic to lead your rider to the victory.



Set out to conquer new cycling races in Tour de France 2025. Discover the Flèche Wallonne, the iconic race of the Ardennes triptych, with its mythical finish at the top of the Mur de Huy. Take part in the original Circuit Grand Est race and discover the stages that make it up. Each race offers the opportunity to forge a little more of your legend and strengthen your reputation as a cyclist.



  • Addition of 5 online rankings in Criterium mode
  • New rewards to unlock in Criterium Mode
  • New Races of the Moment and Descents of the Moment
  • Redesigned home menu
  • New graphics options
  • Added accessibility options for color-blind users
  • Smoother navigation in the peloton
  • Reworked sprint AI
